drhp.business: The Company designs and manufactures scientific research and laboratory instrumentation spanning imaging, measuring, spectroscopy and analytical instruments, physics laboratory equipment, opto-mechanics and optics, breadboards/tabletops/rails and overhead shelves, linear and rotation stages (manual and motorised) and industrial automation. It sells to IITs and research institutions, universities and IISERs, government e-marketplace (GeM) and formal tenders, and private customers such as pharmaceutical companies, supported by a dealer network in India and overseas. risks.note: The imposition of higher tariffs by the United States and continuing conflicts in the Middle East have adversely impacted the Company's export business by affecting international trade, logistics and supply chains; geopolitical disruption is also listed among SWOT threats for freight and supply chains.
risks.risk: Export exposure to tariffs and geopolitical conflict

risks.note: Increasing competition from low-cost products imported from China, plus unorganised local manufacturers offering cheap products, intensifies price competition and poses quality-related challenges in the market.
risks.risk: Price competition from low-cost imports and unorganised local manufacturers

risks.note: In the academic segment procurement decisions are often driven by affordability rather than advanced features, which may limit adoption of the Company's high-end scientific instruments — relevant given the concentration of tender activity in IITs, research institutions, universities and IISERs.
risks.risk: Affordability-driven procurement in the academic segment

risks.note: A shortage of skilled professionals to operate and maintain sophisticated systems, together with changing attitudes towards work and talent retention, is flagged both as a business risk and as a SWOT weakness/threat for a technology-intensive manufacturer.
risks.risk: Shortage of skilled talent and workforce retention

risks.note: Management lists rising operational costs among its business risks, while high capital investment and maintenance costs associated with advanced technologies are cited as a weakness.
risks.risk: Rising operational costs and high capital/maintenance cost of advanced technologies

risks.note: Complex and evolving regulatory and compliance requirements are flagged both in Risks & Concerns and as a SWOT weakness; CSR obligations under Section 135 also become applicable from FY2026-27 as the Company has now met the prescribed net-profit threshold.

Delayed adoption and integration of Artificial Intelligence technologies is listed as a weakness in a market where AI, automation and digitalisation are the stated growth drivers for scientific research equipment.
Irregular power supply is flagged as a threat affecting manufacturing operations and productivity.
